# Mamdouh "Dan" Aly: Senior Shopify Developer, Cairo, Egypt

> Mamdouh "Dan" Aly is a senior Shopify developer and front-end engineer based in Cairo, Egypt, with 9+ years in front-end development and 8 years on Shopify. Dan has worked on more than 264 Shopify websites, mostly for fashion and lifestyle brands, building performance-first storefronts, upsell and cross-sell systems and conversion-focused UX for clients in Egypt, the Gulf, Europe and the US. Recent builds include Women'secret stores for Jordan, Egypt and Kuwait, AYA-S (aya-s.com), Volcom, KOI Footwear, The Mason's and Oshoplin.

- Title: Senior Shopify Developer & Front-End Engineer
- Also known as: Dan Aly, Mamdouh Aly (Arabic: ممدوح علي)
- Location: Cairo, Egypt. Works remotely with brands worldwide
- Languages: English, Arabic
- Experience: 264+ Shopify websites built or worked on
- Recent builds: Women'secret (Jordan, Egypt and Kuwait stores), AYA-S (aya-s.com, complete store), Volcom, KOI Footwear, The Mason's, Oshoplin
- Skills: Shopify, Shopify Plus, Liquid, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, Hydrogen, Flutter
- Services: custom Shopify themes (Liquid, Online Store 2.0), Shopify front-end development, performance and Core Web Vitals, upsells, cross-sells and cart, Shopify Plus (Checkout Extensibility, Functions, Markets, Flow), headless (Hydrogen, React), integrations, Arabic/English right-to-left stores for Egypt and the Gulf
- Featured builds: Alo Yoga (cross-sell and Complete-the-Look engine, Egypt storefront), Volcom (collection and product pages, Klarna, Get the Fit), Oshoplin (multi-brand fashion storefront, Egypt)
- Also engineered and contributed for: Cole Haan, Vestiaire Collective, The Giving Movement, Pier 1, Skechers, ECCO, ANTA, Umbro, The Bradery, KOI, dressbarn, Cizaro
- Rate: $12/hour. Typical Shopify store build: 90–110 hours, about 14 days ($1,080–$1,320). Custom website: up to 150 hours (up to $1,800)
- Contact: mamdohali720@gmail.com, WhatsApp +20 102 212 7566
